scenario_1_normal_friction.description: Normal friction operates continuously in TRUST with zero latch trips and zero false abstentions

scenario_2_friction_degradation.description: Friction drop trips latch at step 15; policy strictly remains in ABSTAIN at step 16 despite zero measured slip

scenario_4_degraded_friction_persists.description: Sustained degraded friction maintains continuous safe hold; zero TRUST/ABSTAIN oscillations; zero drops

scenario_5_recovery_satisfied.description: Restored friction (mu=0.60 at step 25) successfully completes dwell and verification micro-probe; safely transitions to TRUST

scenario_6_recovery_unverified.description: Degraded friction during recovery check fails verification micro-probe and fails closed to TERMINAL_ABSTAIN
